# PhoneFarm ICU (phonefarm.icu)

> Guangzhou real-device phone farm hardware manufacturer — B2B catalog and quote site.

## About
PhoneFarm ICU designs and assembles phone farm racks, motherboard boxes, fan cooling racks, USB hubs, power supplies, cables, and network modules in Guangzhou, China. The site is a B2B product catalog for requesting hardware quotes — not a SaaS platform or cloud phone service.

## Products
Phone farm rack, motherboard box, Android/iPhone farm hardware, fan cooling rack, USB hub, power supply, network equipment, custom cabinet, remote control setup service.

## Primary actions
- Request a quote: https://phonefarm.icu/contact
- Browse catalog: https://phonefarm.icu/products
- Compare packages: https://phonefarm.icu/packages
- Reference pricing: https://phonefarm.icu/pricing
- Knowledge base: https://phonefarm.icu/knowledge-base
